name: chatbot-db
description: PostgreSQL schema and repository for chatbot conversations with Prisma + raw SQL options
postMessage:
Merge schema.prisma into your existing Prisma schema, or run migration.sql directly.
See repository.ts for the data access layer.

Quick start:
  1. psql -d your_db -f src/chatbot-db/migration.sql
  2. npx tsx src/chatbot-db/seed.ts
